name: Multi-Role_Collaboration_Bench
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate multi-role collaborative capabilities in interactive tasks where agents assume different roles and must coordinate to complete joint objectives. It measures performance on role-aware dialogue, planning, and multi-turn cooperation, emphasizing communication, task allocation, and consistency across roles. The suite is intended to test models' ability to maintain coherent multi-agent interactions and accomplish shared goals.
reputation: A recent, research-oriented benchmark with limited but growing use in studies of multi-agent and role-based conversational systems.
